verdict.rationale: Migration credits are a fair pricing question for a hosting/deployment platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions migration credits, switching incentives, or credits for moving production infrastructure. The only billing-related item is a one-off discount on a DDoS overage bill, which is a different matter and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform
